name: Fabric Manufacture Laboratory-I
description: Introduction to weaving: warp preparation - winding, warping, sizing; loom setup, primary and secondary motions; Dobby/Jacquard systems, loom components - picker, reed, heald shafts, shuttle; fabric construction—plain, twill and satin; drafting and lifting plan, woven fabric CAD, production calculation - loom efficiency, production rate, fabric GSM; shuttleless looms.
